name: better-seo
description: Audit and set up a site's classic SEO and agentic-search visibility, so pages get cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews and Claude.

interface.shortDescription: SEO audit and SEO setup, with a stdlib CLI.
interface.longDescription: Two skills: better-seo audits a live page (crawl gates, on-page rules, structured data, AI-crawler policy) and better-seo-build scaffolds robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt, canonical, meta tags and JSON-LD into a project in its own framework conventions.
